newsitem.title: USA: Texas February unemployment rate at 5.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: Texas February unemployment rate at 5.6 percent.

text.p: Texas' February unemployment rate rose two-tenths of a percentage point to a seasonally adjusted 5.6 percent, the highest monthly level since July 1996, the Texas Workforce Commission reported Tuesday.

Though employment rose over the month, the number of unemployed Texans showed a bigger increase, a Commission release said. However, while unemployment hit its highest level since July 1996, the rate was still three-tenths of a percentage point below the year-ago rate.
"It is still too early to determine whether the slight increases we have seen over the previous two months represent a trend in the statewide unemployment rate," the release said.
